crossRefs.note: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be…
But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge…
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

translations.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
translations.bsb: Now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command
translations.asv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
